# Mac app — Inspector

## Inspector

![Inspector](data:image/webp;base64,)

### InspectorView.swift
- inspector column (system .inspector) width 340–760 ideal 360; bg surface
- toolbar primaryAction trailing: InterruptButton (when running), panel toggle: 'panel' icon 15 + count 11 medium
- panel header pad 10: SegmentedPill small (Artifacts n / Changes / Browser n / Terminal / Details) horizontal scroll + xmark icon button 28 'Close panel'
- ArtifactsTab: empty 'No artifacts yet' 'Files the agent writes to its artifacts folder show up here and render inline.'; list (if >1) rows h32 pad h12 capsule surface3 when on: kind icon 13 fg3 + name 12.5 medium (fg on / fg2) + reltime 10.5 fg4; maxH 168; then ArtifactViewer on bg

### InspectorTabs.swift
- BrowserTab: LiveBrowserView with trailing 'Screenshots (3)' (photo); screenshots view: ghost 28 '‹ Live browser' + '3 screenshots' 11 fg4; grid 2 cols gap 8: 4:3 image r12 line stroke + reltime 10.5 fg4, pad 4 bg r16
- empty: 'No screenshots yet' 'When the agent takes a screenshot in the channel browser, it collects here.'
- ShotViewer sheet 880x640: name 13 medium + date 11 fg3; Newer/Older chevrons icon buttons; primary 'Done' 28; hairline; image on surface2
- DetailsTab pad h10: rows block bg r20 pv4; row: key 12.5 fg3 w104 + value fg; pad 14x9; hairline between. Keys: Channel (#link medium), Role, Harness (logo 14 + name), Model, Effort, Source ('automation · nightly'), Branch (mono 12), Working dir (mono), Session (mono + StatusDot 6 'Live, the next message starts instantly' / 'Not running, the next message starts a new process' fg3), Task, Parent (dot + title), MCP ('4 connected · 1 not connected' + Show/Hide; Chip needs for bad), Created, Updated, Last run ('4m 12s · 3 turns')
- Delegated threads: caption + count 11 fg3; rows h36 pad h12: StatusDot 7, title, task 11 mono fg4, '#channel' 11 fg3; container pad 4 bg r20
- Resume in terminal card: caption + secondary 28 Copy/Copied (copy/check 13); command 11.5 mono fg2 surface r12 pad 12x10; card pad 14 bg r20

### ChangesTab.swift
- SegmentedPill small 'Since base' / 'This turn' pad h14; gap 10
- header: 'Base 9e1c0af, main 3 days ago' 12 fg3 (sha 11.5 mono fg); '4 files  +128  -14 on omni/t-4f2b' 11; refresh icon button 28
- groups: 'Committed 2' 11.5 medium fg3 (count fg4) pad h6; files DiffFileView gap 8; 'More files changed than are listed here.'
- This turn: PickerPill (diff icon) 'Turn 3 · 14:02'; note 11.5 fg4; states Loading/Error/EmptyNote 'No changes' 'Nothing in the worktree changed during this turn.'
- empties: 'No changes to show', 'No turns saved yet' 'Each turn's changes are saved here when it ends.'

### DiffView.swift
- DiffFileView: r18 line stroke clip; header h40 pad h14 surface (hover surface2): Chevron fg3, badge letter 11 mono fg3 w12 (M/A/D/?), path 12 mono fg, '+12' fg2 '-3' fg3 11
- lines: mono 11.5 pv2; numbers w36 fg4 right + pr4 (old, new); text pl4 pr12; hunk fg3 on surface; add fg on diffAdd; del fg on diffDelete; context fg2; note fg4
- 'Binary file' note 12 fg3; 'Show 240 more lines' 12 medium fg3 minH36 after hairline
- 'No diff.' 13 fg3

### TerminalTab.swift
- header h32 pad h14: terminal 13 fg3 + cwd 11.5 mono fg3 (truncate head) | trash icon 26 'Close the shell' / pill small 'Restart' (arrow.clockwise)
- error 12 fg2 ('Terminal disconnected. Reconnecting.')
- shell: bg #141518 r12 pad 8, margin h10 bottom10; text #eceae5 12 mono; ANSI palette 2a2c31 ff7b72 7ee787 e3b341 79c0ff d2a8ff 76e3ea d0cfca / 6f6e69 ffa198 aff5b4 f2cc60 a5d6ff e2c5ff b3f0ff ffffff; '[process exited with code 0]' dim

### LiveBrowserView.swift
- frame: tab strip h34 (tabs: icon 15 + label 12, fg on / fg3, pl11 pr4 min60 max208 h32, active bg with top radii 12; close xmark icon 18; '+' new tab icon 26) then body bg clipped r14: toolbar pad 6 gap 2: back/forward/reload(or stop) icon 28; address pill: lock.fill/magnifyingglass/info 10.5 semibold fg3 + field 13 'Search Google or type a URL', pad h11 h30 surface2 (editing: bg + lineStrong 2 stroke); trailing; 1px line with loading sweep (35% fg3 capsule 1.2s)
- error row: triangle fg3 + 12 fg2 + secondary 26 'Restart'
- waiting: Loader 12 + 'Waiting for the page' / 'Starting the browser' 12.5 fg3
